result.brief: 提出语言条件化的 JEPA 式潜空间世界模型，用自然语言统一描述动作与视觉变化，实现跨仿真、机器人轨迹与图像视频数据的联合未来预测，并支持想象规划与策略微调。
result.reason: Language-conditioned JEPA latent world model trained across simulation, robot and video data; compares against RAE-based video generation baseline, contributing to latent world modeling and representation learning.
